blocks.title: Buffer solutions
blocks.text: Woh solutions jo thora sa acid ya base dalne par apne pH ki tabdeeli ko rokte (resist karte) hain, buffer solutions kehlate hain.
In ka pH ek khaas constant qeemat ka hota hai, aur pani mila kar patla (dilute) karne ya der tak rakhne se bhi un ka pH nahi badalta.
Buffer solutions aam taur par do cheezen mila kar banaye jate hain:

items: Weak acid aur strong base ke saath us ka salt mila kar. Is se acidic buffer banta hai jis ka pH 7 se kam hota hai. Acetic acid aur sodium acetate ka mixture is ki behtareen misal hai.
Weak base aur strong acid ke saath us ka salt mila kar. Is se basic buffer banta hai jis ka pH 7 se zyada hota hai. NH₄OH aur NH₄Cl ka mixture is ki behtareen misal hai.

blocks.text: CH₃COOH aur CH₃COONa ke acidic buffer ki misal lein. CH₃COOH weak electrolyte hai aur bohat kam dissociate hota hai. Jab is mein CH₃COONa (strong electrolyte) dala jaye to CH₃COO⁻ ke common ion effect ki wajah se CH₃COOH ka dissociation aur dab jata hai.

Jitna zyada CH₃COONa dalte jayen, CH₃COO⁻ utna barhta hai, CH₃COOH ka dissociation utna kam hota hai aur solution ka pH barhta hai. Table 9.4 dikhati hai ke mixture ka pH kaise qaim rehta hai. CH₃COONa ke muqable acetic acid jitna zyada ho, pH utna kam hota hai.

blocks.text: Asal mein yeh buffer CH₃COOH aur CH₃COO⁻ ka ek bara zakheera (reservoir) hai. Jab is mein acid (H₃O⁺ ions) dala jaye to woh CH₃COO⁻ se react kar ke wapas acetic acid ban jate hain, is liye pH taqreeban wahi rehta hai; wajah yeh hai ke CH₃COOH weak acid hai aur bina dissociate hue rehna pasand karta hai. Isi tarah NH₄Cl aur NH₄OH wala buffer bahar se acid ya base dalne par pH aur pOH ki tabdeeli rokta hai. Jab base (OH⁻ ions) dala jaye to woh H₃O⁺ se react kar ke wapas H₂O bana dete hain aur pH phir taqreeban wahi rehta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein “week acid” chhapa hai; sahi “weak acid” hai.

blocks.prompt: Acetate buffer NaOH ke chand qatron aur HCl ke chand qatron ka muqabla kaise karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Dala gaya OH⁻ buffer ke CH₃COOH se react karta hai: CH₃COOH + OH⁻ → CH₃COO⁻ + H₂O, is liye OH⁻ kharch ho jata hai. Dala gaya H⁺ acetate se react karta hai: CH₃COO⁻ + H⁺ → CH₃COOH, is liye H⁺ kharch ho jata hai. Sirf acid aur salt ka tanasub (ratio) thora badalta hai, is liye pH bohat kam badalta hai.

items: Buffer thora acid ya base dalne aur dilute karne par bhi pH nahi badalne deta.
Acidic buffer: weak acid + us ka salt (CH₃COOH/CH₃COONa), pH 7 se kam. Basic buffer: weak base + us ka salt (NH₄OH/NH₄Cl), pH 7 se zyada.
Acetate dalne se acetic acid ka dissociation 1.3% se 0.012% tak girta hai aur pH 2.89 se 4.92 tak barhta hai (Table 9.4).
